subject: general
question: The Planning Commission was the apex body responsible for formulating Five-Year Plans. In which year was the Planning Commission of India established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1950**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Planning Commission of India was established in the year **1950**, specifically on **15 March 1950**, by a resolution of the Government of India.
 
• It was tasked with the responsibility of creating **Five-Year Plans** for the economic development and growth of the country.
 
• The Planning Commission was set up under the leadership of **Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru**, the first Prime Minister of India, who served as its chairman.
 
• The main objective of the Planning Commission was to promote a rapid increase in the standard of living of the citizens through efficient utilization of resources.
 
• It was replaced by the **NITI Aayog** (National Institution for Transforming India) on **1 January 2015**, which serves as the policy think tank of the Government of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1948**

 
 
• Although 1948 was an important year for post-independence economic planning discussions, the Planning Commission had not been formally established yet.
 
• The **Industrial Policy Resolution of 1948** was introduced, which laid the groundwork for India's economic development in the subsequent years.
 
• This resolution emphasized the importance of public and private sectors in India's industrial development.
 
 
 
• **1951**
 
 
• The year 1951 marked the launch of India's **First Five-Year Plan**, which focused on agricultural development and infrastructure building.
 
• While the Planning Commission was established in 1950, its first major task was to develop the First Five-Year Plan, which officially began implementation in 1951.
 
• This plan aimed to address food security and alleviate poverty in the country.
 
 
 
• **1952**
 
 
• 1952 was significant for the establishment of the **Community Development Programme**, which aimed to promote rural development.
